DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車に何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened to your bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 停めていた自転車が倒れ、かごが曲がっていました。誰が倒したかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車転倒かご損傷と原因未目撃を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My parked bicycle had fallen over, and the basket was bent. I did not see who knocked it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the bicycle fell over and its basket was damaged, and that you did not witness the cause. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見つけた時刻と場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me when and where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の午後四時、駅前の右の列です。朝は倒れていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見時刻場所と朝の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At four this afternoon, in the row on the right in front of the station. It was not lying down this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when and where you found it and its condition in the morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 起こす前の写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a photograph from before you stood it up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 撮りました。起こした後の写真もあります。元の位置が分かるよう、二つを分けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 起こす前後の写真を分けて提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I took one. I also have photographs after standing it up. I have kept the two sets separate so its original position is clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present the photographs from before and after standing it up separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに見えた損傷はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you notice any other damage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かご以外は自分でよく分かりません。乗れると決めず、修理店にも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認損傷と修理店確認の予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I cannot tell for myself about anything apart from the basket. I will not assume it is rideable; I will also check with a bicycle repair shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that other damage is unconfirmed and that you plan to check with a repair shop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 近くにいた方へ、何かお聞きになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you asked anyone who was nearby about it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一人に聞きましたが、その人も見ていません。誰かの話を目撃した事実として加えず、確認した範囲を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他人も未目撃で確認範囲のみ報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I asked one person, but that person had not seen it either. I will report only what I have checked, without adding someone else's account as though it were something I witnessed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that the other person did not witness it either, and report only what you have checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所、時刻、写真で相談を受け付けます。原因の不明と確認できた状態を分けて担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We can take your report based on the location, time, and photographs. Please distinguish the unknown cause from the condition you confirmed when speaking to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの絵はがきをお出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending this picture postcard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。宛名面にもメッセージを書いたので、切手を貼る四角の中まで文字が入ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切手欄までメッセージを書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote a message on the address side too, and my writing has gone into the square where the stamp goes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote the message into the stamp area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切手は、もう貼りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already put the stamp on?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。文字を隠したくなくて、裏の絵の面に貼ろうかと思いました。貼る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切手は未貼付で裏面に貼る前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I did not want to cover the writing, so I was thinking of putting it on the picture side on the back. I would like to check before attaching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the stamp is not attached and that you want to check before putting it on the back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 裏へ貼る前に、宛名面の配置を確認しましょう。宛先の文字と重なっていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before putting it on the back, let's check the layout on the address side. Does it overlap the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宛名は右側で読めます。切手欄に入ったのは最後の一文だけです。宛名の上へ重ねるのも避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名は読めることと重なる一文の位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The address is on the right and is readable. Only the last sentence extends into the stamp area. I also want to avoid covering the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the address is readable and where the sentence overlaps the stamp area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後の一文を別の場所に書き直すか、別のはがきを使う方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You could rewrite the last sentence somewhere else, or use another postcard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この絵はがきを使いたいので、最後の一文を余白へ書き直して、元の文を消します。切手を貼る場所が空いたら、もう一度見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じはがきの一文を書き直し配置確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to use this picture postcard, so I will rewrite the last sentence in a blank space and erase the original sentence. Once the stamp area is clear, could you take another look?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will rewrite a sentence on the same postcard and ask for another layout check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。文字と切手が重ならない状態でお持ちください。今はまだ受付していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please bring it back with the writing and stamp no longer overlapping. We have not accepted it for posting yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。まだ出していないはがきを持ち帰り、一文の位置を直してから宛名面へ切手を貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付前のはがきを持ち帰り文字の位置を直してから切手を貼ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will take the postcard that has not yet been posted home, move the sentence, and then attach the stamp on the address side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the unaccepted postcard home, adjust the writing's position, and then attach the stamp. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらをお返しします。宛名が読める状態も確認してからお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here it is back. Please also check that the address is readable before posting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 残高の確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check your balance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今月二つ引落しがあります。一つ払える分はありますが、もう一つを計算に入れていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二件引落しの一件だけ計算したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have two direct debits this month. I have enough for one, but I had not included the other in my calculations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you calculated for only one of two direct debits and ask for help. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの金額と予定日は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the amount and scheduled date of each?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この請求書です。同じ日ですが、別の会社の二件です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別会社同日の額予定を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here are the bills. They are on the same day, but they are two payments to different companies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the amounts and scheduled date for two different companies on the same day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在残高と、ほかの支払いも整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also work out your current balance and other payments.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。残高が一件の金額より多いだけで、全部足りるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一件分超残高でも全額充足でないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help me with that. I will not assume there is enough for everything just because the balance is higher than the amount of one payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that a balance exceeding one payment does not mean it covers all payments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認したい取引記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any transaction records you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: すでに払った分の記録です。二件のうちどちらが済んだか、請求名も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 済んだ請求を名称記録で特定したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The records for what I have already paid. I would also like to see the billing names to identify which of the two is settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to identify the settled bill using its name and transaction record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。未払い分だけを足し、必要な準備をします。済んだ分をまた払わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未済分のみ計算し二重払を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will add up only the unpaid amounts and make the necessary arrangements. I will avoid paying again for what has already been settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add up only unpaid amounts and avoid double payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 取引名と日付を照合してください。請求先の状況はそれぞれの会社にもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please compare the transaction names and dates. Please also check the status of each bill with the respective company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the fruit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日、友人へ渡します。今日すぐ食べる物と、選び方が違うか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翌日贈る果物の選び方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will give some to a friend tomorrow. I would like to ask whether I should choose differently from fruit to eat straight away today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to choose fruit to give as a gift tomorrow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 渡した後はすぐ食べられる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will they eat it right after you give it to them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 週末に家族と食べるそうです。見た目がきれいなだけで決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 週末の家族喫食予定と外観だけで選ばないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: They say they will eat it with their family at the weekend. I do not want to choose just because it looks attractive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the plan to eat it with family at the weekend and that you will not choose on appearance alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 種類と状態を担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can discuss the varieties and their condition with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。明日の受渡しと週末の喫食を伝え、持ち運び方も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受渡日喫食日と運搬を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I would like to explain that I am handing it over tomorrow and that they will eat it at the weekend, and ask how to carry it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss the handover date, eating date, and transport. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち帰りの時間はどのくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: How long will your journey home take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三十分です。箱を傾けないよう持ち、上に重い買物袋を載せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持帰時間とつぶさない持ち方を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thirty minutes. I will carry the box without tilting it and will not put heavy shopping bags on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the journey time and how you will carry it without crushing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 数はいくつ必要ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四人で食べるので、その人数に合う量を相談します。大きい箱なら必ずよいとは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四人分の適量を求め箱の大きさを優先しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Four people will eat it, so I would like advice on an amount suitable for that number. I do not assume a bigger box is always better.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a suitable amount for four people without prioritizing the size of the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 渡す日と食べる予定を担当へ伝えます。量と状態を見て候補をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the person in charge when you will give it to them and when they plan to eat it. We will suggest options based on quantity and condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この付近は清掃中です。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人とこのベンチで待ち合わせですが、別の場所へ変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃中の集合ベンチを変更すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Understood. I arranged to meet my friend at this bench, but I will change the meeting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you will change the meeting bench because cleaning is in progress. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口の案内板の横なら待てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can wait beside the information board at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこへ移り、友人へ今連絡します。作業員の方に終わるまで急いでほしいとは頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 代替案内板へ連絡し作業を急かさないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will move there and contact my friend now. I will not ask the workers to hurry up and finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will move to the alternative information board, contact your friend, and not rush the workers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人はもう向かっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is your friend already on the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。元の場所へ来たら作業の中を通らず、案内板へ来るよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へ清掃区画を通らない経路を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will tell them that if they come to the original place, they should come to the information board without walking through the work area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your friend a route that avoids the area being cleaned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移動後に返事を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check for a reply after moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。返事がない時は案内板に残り、二人とも動いてすれ違うのを避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信なしなら固定場所で待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. If there is no reply, I will stay at the information board so we do not both move and miss each other.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to wait in one fixed place if there is no reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物はこの区画に残さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not leave your belongings in this area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部持って移ります。集合先の変更と荷物の受取が済んだことを、友人へ一緒に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を全部持ち変更と受取を一緒に連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take everything with me. I will tell my friend both that the meeting place has changed and that I have collected the belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take all belongings and report both the change and collection together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内板の横をご利用ください。清掃区画を通らず、外側の通路をお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use the space beside the information board. Follow the passage around the outside without entering the cleaning area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換えの道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the way to transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。連れが足を痛めているので、階段を使わない経路を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 足の悪い同行者の階段なし乗換経路を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My companion has an injured leg, so please show us a route without stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a transfer route without stairs for a companion with a leg problem. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you also have a lot of luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい鞄だけです。近い階段より、少し遠くてもエレベーターのある道を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物少なく遠回りでも昇降機を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only a small bag. I would prefer a route with an elevator, even if it is a little farther, to the nearby stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have little luggage and prefer an elevator even with a detour. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図の緑の線が、その経路です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The green line on the map is that route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 緑の線ですね。途中で階段の近道へ戻らないよう、分かれ道の表示も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 緑線と途中分岐の表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The green line, right? I would also like to ask about signs at the junctions so we do not end up taking a shortcut with stairs along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the green line and signs at junctions along the route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 右側のエレベーター表示に沿って進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please follow the elevator signs on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。連れと一緒に進み、私だけ先に次の乗り場へ行かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者と一緒に進み先行しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will stay with my companion and make sure I do not go ahead to the next platform on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will walk with your companion and not go ahead. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗換え時間に余裕はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have enough time for the transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 少しあります。間に合わなければ次の案内を聞き、階段を無理に急がせません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不足時間なら次便相談で無理に急がせない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We have a little time. If we cannot make it, we will ask about the next service and will not force my companion to hurry up the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about the next service if time is short and will not make your companion rush. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 右の表示でエレベーターへどうぞ。時間より、移動できる経路を確かめてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow the signs on the right to the elevator. Check that the route is one you can use, rather than focusing on the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ごみの出し方でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about disposing of rubbish?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚を処分したいです。小さい棚ですが、何ごみか分からないので寸法を測ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚処分で寸法測定済みと区分を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to dispose of a shelf. It is small, but I do not know which rubbish category it belongs to, so I measured it before coming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the disposal category for a shelf and say you have measured it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのくらいの大きさですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 幅六十、高さ八十、奥行き三十センチです。自分には小さく見えても、区分は別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三寸法と主観サイズを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sixty centimetres wide, eighty high, and thirty deep. Even if it looks small to me, the classification is a separate matter, isn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give all three dimensions and distinguish them from your subjective impression of size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ品名と寸法を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person in charge the item name and dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。分解すれば普通のごみにできると、先に決めて切るのはやめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己分解で普通ごみにする前提を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I decided against cutting it up first on the assumption that dismantling it would make it ordinary rubbish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold off on assuming that dismantling it yourself will make it ordinary rubbish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know what it is made of?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 木と金属が使われています。写真もあるので、一つの材質だけとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 木金属の複合材と写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It contains wood and metal. I also have photographs, so I will not describe it as being made of just one material.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that it combines wood and metal, along with photographs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出す日と場所も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the disposal day and location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。区分が分かってから申込みの要否、収集日、出す場所を順番に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区分後に申込要否日場所を順に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Once I know the category, I will ask in order whether an application is needed, the collection date, and where to put it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After confirming the category, ask in order about application requirements, the date, and the location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 寸法と写真を担当へお見せください。案内が決まるまで外へ出さずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the person in charge the dimensions and photographs. Keep it indoors until the disposal instructions have been established.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の受付をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will explain today's reception procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。ここは声が聞き取りにくいです。ゆっくり話すか、要点を文字で見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聴取困難でゆっくり又は文字説明を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me. It is difficult to hear voices here. Could you speak slowly or show me the main points in writing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your difficulty hearing and ask for slow speech or written guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which part would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付後にどこへ行くかです。言葉が分からない部分と、音が聞こえない部分があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行先と言語理解音声聴取の二問題を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Where to go after reception. There are parts where I do not understand the words, and parts where I cannot hear the sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your destination question and the two difficulties: understanding language and hearing speech. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの案内票を使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use this information slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。指で順番を示してもらえれば、自分でも確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内票を指で順に示すよう求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. If you point out the steps in order with your finger, I can check them myself too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the information slip to be pointed through in order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最初はこちらの検査受付です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: First, go to this examination reception desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この検査受付へ先に行くのですね。番号の呼出しも文字で見られるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最初の行先を復唱し文字呼出しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I go to this examination reception desk first. I would also like to ask whether number calls can be seen in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat your first destination and ask about written number calls. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 呼出しの方法を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the person in charge how people are called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。分かった順番を復唱し、次の場所へ進みます。聞こえたふりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 理解した順番を確認して移動すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I will repeat the order I have understood before moving to the next place. I will not pretend I heard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm the order you understood before moving on. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内票をお持ちください。呼出し方法の希望も、担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the information slip. I will also tell the person in charge your preference about how you are called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 電話についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about a telephone call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。銀行の名前を名乗る人から、すぐお金を送れと言われました。本当に銀行かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行名を名乗る未確認相手の送金要求を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Someone claiming to be from a bank told me to send money immediately. I do not know whether they really are from the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a money-transfer demand from an unverified caller claiming to represent a bank. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。番号や暗証番号も伝えていません。電話を切って相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未送金未情報開示で終話したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I have not given them any numbers or my PIN either. I ended the call and came here for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you ended the call without sending money or disclosing information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: かかってきた時刻と番号は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you still have the time and number of the incoming call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この履歴です。表示された番号だけで、銀行からだと断定はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 着信履歴を示し表示番号を身元証明としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the call history. I have not concluded it was the bank based only on the displayed number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the call history without treating the displayed number as proof of identity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手が言った内容も整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also organize what the caller said.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口座が止まると言っていました。相手の言葉として記録し、実際に停止した事実とは分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手の停止発言と実際の停止事実を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: They said my account would be suspended. I will record that as their words and distinguish it from an actual suspension.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the caller's claim of suspension from an actual account suspension. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 銀行へ確認する予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you plan to check with the bank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。電話で教えられた番号ではなく、以前から持っている案内の連絡先へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既存銀行連絡先で確認する意思を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check using the contact information in guidance I already had, rather than the number they gave me over the phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you intend to check using the bank's previously held contact information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 履歴と内容を担当へお見せください。送金前の相談として受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the person in charge the call history and what was said. We will take this as a consultation before any money transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。切手を貼った後で資料を三枚追加しました。最初の料金で足りるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切手後三枚追加で料金再確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. After putting the stamps on, I added three sheets of documents. I would like to check whether the original postage is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to recheck postage after adding three sheets following stamp attachment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の封筒の重さを量りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's weigh the envelope as it is now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。前に量った時と、中身が変わっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前計量時と内容変更を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please. The contents have changed since it was weighed before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the contents have changed since the earlier weighing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加した資料以外に変更はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Has anything changed apart from the added documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宛先は同じです。封筒も同じですが、重さまで同じとは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛先封筒同じでも重量別と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The destination is the same. The envelope is the same too, but that does not mean the weight is the same, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the weight can differ even with the same destination and envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の重さと貼った切手の額を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the current weight and the value of the stamps attached.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 不足があれば追加します。自分で切手をはがして、別の封筒へ移すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不足額追加を希望し切手転用しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the postage is short, I will add the difference. I will not peel off the stamps myself and transfer them to another envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to add any postage shortfall and say you will not reuse the stamps elsewhere. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この封筒で差し出されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you be posting it in this envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。料金を直してから封を閉じ、最後の枚数も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料金修正後に最終枚数封緘を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will correct the postage, then seal it and check the final number of sheets too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the final sheet count and sealing after correcting the postage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今の中身で料金をご案内します。追加が必要か確認してから差出しを受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will advise you on postage for the current contents. We will accept it for posting after checking whether additional postage is needed.
